observations: Torah 92 is one of the shortest Torahs in Likutay Moharan — it is a practical instruction (a tikkun) that explicitly defers to LM1 Torah 205 for the full conceptual framework. The text contains only one explicit bechina equation: the ten Psalm chapters correspond to (כנגד) the ten types of melody. All other relationships in the text are either functional/eitza (the melodies nullify the klipa; the chapters are the tikkun for the nocturnal emission) or oppositional (the melodies are the הֶפֶךְ — the opposite — of the klipa). No three or more concepts are connected by explicit bechina language forming an independent domain. The concepts of קלפה, פגם, and מקרה לילה appear only in eitza/oppositional roles. The messianic promise at the end (ובזכות תיקון חטא זה יבוא משיח) is a directional consequence (eitza), not a bechina cluster. Therefore no new packages are proposed.
